Un yinna katamiti waayito bi7i zhashtide gisho hyaakkii eqqii,

content.text: Nena fettii saate gidda firdda yellida› gawuda.

content: «Un markkabite yeze caantto yikkeppa gode wonggize asi baayze gisho sa7a yeze zal7izuntsi yinna katamitis yeekkoda azzanoda;

Un worqqa, bira, bonchcho shuchchi, inqo gaaze al77o shuchchi, bonchcho ma7o, liino ma7o, haare ma7o, zoqo ma7o, dumma dumma sawo minxa, danggars achchi, al77on bonchcho minxa, naase, meqqon, ibine beredeppa medhinttide miishe ubba,
qerefa, qimaame, sawize minxa, karbbe, ixaane, woyne, zayte, liiqo dhiilla, zarga, hyaari, duro, fara, fara gaare, aron melle asuntsin yene.
«Zal7izuntsi, ‹Neenii amudhdhide lo77o baz ubba neeppa aadhida. Ne yessitan ne falimo miishita ubba neeppa hyaakkida. Asuntsi yikkeppa mahi yinno denggaama› yagayda.
Yinno zal7i duridhdhide ubba yeekkiteran azzanitera,

content.text: « ‹Liino ma7o, lee7o ma7on zoqo ma7o ma77i,

content: «Fettii saate dhabida yaga7i hyanqito zhashtidannippa denddii hyaako eqqida. «Markkabiza izhize ubba, markkabzera qitize ubba, markkabizella afa oochchize ubba Abballa zal7ize ubba hyaakkii eqqida.
Yinna katamita eexin kezize cugito bi7ide wode ‹Hyanna damma katamito aazize melle katama yene yessane?› yaga7i uukkida.
Un fa ommite bul7a gussii, yeekkiteran kaayidhitera,

content.text: Xoozii yin gisho iilla afa firddide gisho ufayttote» yagayda.

content: Fettii mintsi kiitanchcho woxa aazize damma shuchchi dentsii abba dhogii, «Damma katamite Baabiloone hyannigaara urqqintti gol7oda; yikkeppa suuba mulon benttoos.

Bagana guuddizuntsin mazmure yexxizunts, suulunqen moyze oollizunts, yikkeppa suuba ne gidda mulon sinttoos. Akko bazin kushe yiillar oochchize asin ne gidda benttoos. Woxa ootsi yikkeppa suuba ne gidda mulon sinttoos.
Xomppe foo7o mahi ne gidda foo7oos. Machcho ekkizen azinii gelize ufayssi qaala yikkeppa suuba ne gidda mulon sinttoos. Zal7izuntsi sa7a erinttide gisho ne bititira ka7itumo mulo balitstsida» gayda.
Nabunts suutsi, geeshshuntsi suutsitan sa7alla afa hyayqqide asunts ubbunts suutsita I gidda benttida.
